The presenter’s face is seen in the background with wide, surprised eyes and an open-mouthed expression. White text "鏡頭超平" and "第一" appear on a light blue background. (3) The camera focuses on the back of the purple phone. Two camera lenses are highlighted with white lines and text indicating "4,800 萬畫素主鏡頭" and "1,300 萬畫素超廣角". The lighting is bright studio style, clearly showing the device's texture. (4) A transition cut shows a brown stuffed otter toy briefly before returning to the presenter. She holds up a large paper illustration of a battery over the back of the phone. Graphics compare battery specs between the Pixel 9a and Pixel 9 Pro XL. (5) The video displays a screen recording of the phone's interface, showing a web page with pink and purple graphics and text. A thumb scrolls through the content. The layout is clean and typical of a modern Android smartphone browsing experience. (6) Finally, the presenter returns to the screen, holding the phone and pointing energetically towards the bottom of the frame where a "下面留言" call-to-action is located. Her expression is cheerful and engaging, inviting viewer interaction.
